items.sentence: Today, the morning painting session lasted almost one happy hour.
Before lunch, the strict but kind teacher checked every desk.
Today, you can twist the cap to open the juice bottle.

Workers form a union to discuss fair pay and safety.
Students compare the loads and identify the maximum weight.
Today, the new semester began with fresh notebooks and bright pencils.

The shop sells colorful stationery next to the small art supplies.
The teacher defines each science term with a clear example.
